segments.contextAfter: `existingPrefilterTag`: The tag of the current Bloom filter.  The system passes the tag of the last fetched Bloom filter, or `nil` for the initial fetch. Your implementation can use this tag to decide if a Bloom filter update is necessary.  If an update isn’t necessary, return `nil` to tell the system to continue using the current Bloom filter.
